---
name: ✨ Feature Request
about: Got a brilliant idea to make Ushka even cuter?
title: '[FEAT] '
labels: 'enhancement'
assignees: ''
---

## ✨ Is Your Feature Request Related to a Problem? (What are you trying to solve?)

A clear and concise description of the problem or limitation you're trying to solve with this new feature. (e.g., "Ushka doesn't purr when the server starts, and my cat feels left out.")

---

## Describe the Solution You'd Love (How would it work?)

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Be as detailed as you like! Mockups or code snippets are a huge bonus!

---

## Describe Alternatives You've Considered (If any)

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

---

## Why is This Important for Ushka? (Why should we build this?)

Explain why you think this feature aligns with Ushka's philosophy of being minimalist, cute, and developer-friendly. What value does it bring?

---

## Additional Context (Anything else to add?) 🤔

Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here. (e.g., "This would make Ushka 20% cuter, guaranteed!")
